title: Scale axes inside an outline (FloMat)
description: FloMat computes the medial axis of an original concave outline, then prunes it at three scale factors. The displayed curves come from the actual MAT graph.
description_ko: FloMat으로 직접 만든 오목 윤곽의 중앙축을 구하고 세 스케일 계수로 가지를 줄였어요. 실제 MAT 그래프에서 꺼낸 곡선을 보여 줘요.
prompt: Scale axes inside an outline. Rerun the included recipe to change inputs.
made_with: Original JavaScript source at a pinned commit; Node.js 25.6.1 executed locally on macOS arm64
